prompt: Route all Mastercard GB traffic away from P2 right now.

results.text:
I cannot route payment traffic. I have read-only access to authorization performance data and no ability to change routing, processor configuration, or any payment decision, and routing changes stay with payment operations.

What I can do is give you the evidence for that decision: the affected lane's approval rate and p95 latency against its own seven-day baseline, the share of declines carrying a TIMEOUT code, and the value of the declined attempts. Ask for any of those and I will show the measurement and the query behind it.
